keystrokes: supervisorctl status; ps aux | grep -E 'supervisord|postgres|redis|nginx' | grep -v grep
ls /var/lib/postgresql/16/main 2>/dev/null | head; ls /opt/appenv/bin/ | head; cat /etc/supervisor/supervisord.conf | tail -20

cat > /opt/webapp/wait_for_db.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Wait until the database has been initialized (items table exists) and redis is up
export DB_HOST=localhost DB_PORT=5432 DB_NAME=appdb DB_USER=appuser DB_PASSWORD=apppass123
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  /opt/appenv/bin/python -c "
import psycopg2, redis, sys
try:
    c = psycopg2.connect(host='localhost', port=5432, database='appdb', user='appuser', password='apppass123')
    cur = c.cursor()
    cur.execute(\"SELECT to_regclass('items'), to_regclass('task_queue')\")
    row = cur.fetchone()
    assert row[0] and row[1]
    c.close()
    redis.Redis(host='localhost', port=6379, password='cachepass456').ping()
except Exception:
    sys.exit(1)
" && exec "$@"
  sleep 1
done
echo "Timed out waiting for database initialization" >&2
exit 1
EOF
chmod +x /opt/webapp/wait_for_db.sh

cat > /etc/supervisor/conf.d/dbinit.conf <<'EOF'
; Database initialization (runs after PostgreSQL is up, before appserver/appworker)
[program:dbinit]
command=/opt/appenv/bin/python /opt/webapp/init_db.py
directory=/opt/webapp
user=root
autostart=true
autorestart=false
startsecs=0
priority=200
stdout_logfile=/var/log/supervisor/dbinit.log
stderr_logfile=/var/log/supervisor/dbinit_err.log
environment=PATH="/opt/appenv/bin:/usr/bin:/bin",DB_HOST="localhost",DB_PORT="5432",DB_NAME="appdb",DB_USER="appuser",DB_PASSWORD="apppass123"
EOF

sed -i 's/^priority=50/priority=300/; s|^command=/opt/appenv/bin/gunicorn|command=/opt/webapp/wait_for_db.sh env REDIS_PASSWORD=cachepass456 /opt/appenv/bin/gunicorn|' /etc/supervisor/conf.d/appserver.conf
sed -i 's/^priority=50/priority=300/; s|^command=/opt/appenv/bin/python /opt/webapp/worker.py|command=/opt/webapp/wait_for_db.sh env REDIS_PASSWORD=cachepass456 /opt/appenv/bin/python /opt/webapp/worker.py|' /etc/supervisor/conf.d/appworker.conf
sed -i 's/^priority=10/priority=400/' /etc/supervisor/conf.d/appproxy.conf
grep -E 'priority|command' /etc/supervisor/conf.d/*.conf
curl -s http://localhost/ ; echo; curl -s http://localhost/health; echo
